events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: A true legend gone too soon, but his voice and showmanship continue to inspire. We're celebrating the life and music of Freddie Mercury today.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Timeless Album
angles.copy: An album that changed everything. The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' still sounds as fresh and innovative as it did back in '65.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the life and legacy of The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon, who passed away 46 years ago.

angles.name: Voice for Peace
angles.copy: A voice for peace and a musical pioneer. We're paying tribute to John Lennon today.
